findings.what: Block is purely passive (capacitors, resistor, connector). No active components to check pin assignments.
ISENSE_P port correctly connects to +12V rail. The current sense shunt resistor is in OUTPUT_SENSE_PROTECT block per architecture.
Voltage ratings adequate: 25V rating on all capacitors provides >2x margin over 12V nominal output.
All ports correctly implemented: RECT_P (input from rectifier), VOUT_SENSE (output for voltage feedback), ISENSE_P (output for current measurement path).

reviewer_notes: OUTPUT_FILTER is a simple passive filter block. Topology is correct and follows standard LLC converter output filtering practice. No connection issues found after two full review passes. Block is ready for value verification by simulator.
